brief: COPY AD — Our own White & Repair FB-comment ad -> LACALUT Sensitive. Keep the layout, sizes, type, panels and finish IDENTICAL to the reference. TEXT SIZE BEATS IMAGE SIZ
genPrompt:
COPY-AD REMAKE. The FIRST attached image is a proven, high-spending competitor Facebook ad. Recreate it as a NEAR-IDENTICAL remake for LACALUT Sensitive (German pharmacy oral care). Target: a viewer who saw both would say "same ad, different brand". KEEP EXACTLY (do not reinterpret, improve, re-compose or add to): the layout grid and every zone's position and size, the background, scene, props, people, poses, crops, camera angle, lighting, colour-blocking, type hierarchy, type sizes, text positions, alignment, badges, arrows, stickers, borders and overall finish. If it is a flat graphic, stay flat; if it is a photo, stay photographic; if it is UGC / lo-fi, stay lo-fi. BACKGROUND COLOUR — MANDATORY CHANGE (the ONE thing that is ALWAYS different from the reference): replace the reference's dominant background / card colour with soft pale teal-aqua #E3F2F3 (LACALUT Sensitive brand background). Keep the same background TYPE (flat card stays a flat card, gradient stays a gradient, photo scene stays a photo scene with its surfaces re-tinted toward this colour), same texture and lighting — only the hue changes. Re-tint any panel borders, pills or outlines that matched the old background so they still sit naturally on the new one. Text colours stay as the reference unless contrast fails, then darken/lighten minimally. SWAP ONLY: (a) their product → the attached LACALUT reference packshot, placed in the SAME spot, SAME scale, SAME angle and SAME lighting as their product (if their product is held, ours is held the same way); (b) their brand name, logo and wording → the LACALUT wording below. Where a line is marked "keep", reproduce it exactly; where it is rewritten, keep the SAME size, weight, colour, case and position for the new words.

4. PRODUCT
What it is: A white toothpaste tube, branded "LACALUT white & repair".
Where it sits: Occupies the bottom 25% of the canvas height, positioned in the bottom right, with its bottom and right edges cropped off the canvas.
Approx % of canvas height: The visible portion of the tube is approximately 30% of the canvas height.
Angle: Tilted upwards from left to right, at approximately a 30-degree angle relative to the horizontal. The tube is also slightly rotated to show its top surface.
Lighting: Bright, even lighting from the top-left, creating subtle shadows.
Shadow/reflection: A soft, diffused shadow is cast directly beneath the tube on the background, indicating it's slightly raised. No prominent reflections.
Held or standing: Standing/lying on a surface, not held.

5. PEOPLE / PROPS / SCENE
Person: Margy Pascoe, a middle-aged woman with short, dark hair and a light-colored top.
Pose: Headshot, slightly smiling, looking directly at the camera.
Expression: Pleasant, friendly, and authentic.
Crop: Circular crop for a profile picture, showing head and shoulders.
Props and their positions:
 Two microscope images of tooth enamel:
  Left image: Shows a surface with numerous small, deep pits and irregularities, labeled "before".
  Right image: Shows a smoother, more uniform surface with fewer and shallower irregularities, labeled "after".
  Both images are grayscale, high-magnification, and appear to be scanning electron microscope (SEM) images. They are positioned side-by-side, centered horizontally, occupying the middle section of the ad.
Camera angle and lens feel:
 For Margy Pascoe: Standard portrait lens, slightly soft focus on the background.
 For microscope images: Scientific, highly detailed, clinical.
 For toothpaste tube: Product photography style, clean, well-lit, slightly wide-angle to emphasize the product.

6. GRAPHIC DEVICES
Facebook comment box: A large, light grey (#F0F2F5) rounded rectangle speech bubble shape, with a small triangular pointer on its bottom-left edge, positioned top-center.
Profile picture circle: A dark grey (#4A4A4A) circular border around Margy Pascoe's headshot, inside the comment box.
Like button icon: A blue (#0078FF) thumbs-up icon, positioned bottom-right of the comment box.
Heart icon: A red (#E60026) heart icon, positioned to the right of the Like button icon.
Reaction count pill: A white (#FFFFFF) rounded rectangle pill shape with a thin grey border (#D8D8D8), containing the number "18", positioned to the right of the heart icon.
Before/after labels: Light grey (#E0E0E0) rounded rectangle pills with black text, positioned top-left of each microscope image.
Tooth icon: A stylized outline of a tooth, white with a grey outline, positioned on the far right of the toothpaste tube. The tooth is filled with a pattern of red and black squares, resembling a checkerboard, with some squares missing or outlined.
Checkerboard pattern: A small, irregular checkerboard pattern in black and white, positioned to the left of the tooth icon on the tube.
Borders: Thin black borders around the two microscope images.

7. COLOUR PALETTE
Light Grey Background: #E8EBEF (dominant background)
Dark Grey Text/Outlines: #4A4A4A (most body text, profile picture border, small print on tube)
Bright Red: #E60026 (LACALUT branding on tube, heart icon)
Facebook Blue: #0078FF (Like button icon)
White: #FFFFFF (toothpaste tube, comment box, reaction count pill, tooth icon fill)
Black: #000000 (main text in comment, "before"/"after" text, "LACALUT White & Repair" headline, microscope image borders)

8. MOOD / FINISH
Lighting: Bright, clean, and even, with soft, diffused shadows. The overall impression is well-lit and professional.
Contrast: Moderate to high contrast, especially in the microscope images and product branding, ensuring readability and detail.
Photo vs render: The background is a subtle digital gradient. The profile picture is a photograph. The microscope images are scientific photographs. The toothpaste tube appears to be a high-quality product photograph or a realistic 3D render. The Facebook UI elements are digital graphics.
Any filter or grain: No apparent filters or grain. The image has a clean, sharp, and modern digital finish.

CHANGES REQUESTED BY THE ART DIRECTOR (the ONLY deliberate differences from the reference — apply exactly, nothing more):
Our own White & Repair FB-comment ad -> LACALUT Sensitive. Keep the layout, sizes, type, panels and finish IDENTICAL to the reference. TEXT SIZE BEATS IMAGE SIZE.
BACKGROUND: the silver-grey card background becomes soft pale teal-aqua #E3F2F3 (Sensitive colour) — same gradient/texture, only the hue changes.
TOP-RIGHT small line: keep "1 million+ happy customers" exactly.
REVIEW COMMENT (same giant Facebook-comment card): avatar = EXTRA image 1 (Dianne's REAL profile photo — use EXACTLY as supplied in the round avatar slot, never redraw or replace the face). Bold name: "Dianne Somerville". Comment text, verbatim, same size as the reference: "This toothpaste has really helped my gum recession and sensitivity." Reaction pill: thumbs-up + heart with the count "14". Under the bubble: "3w   Like   Reply" then "View 3 replies". No emojis added anywhere.
BEFORE/AFTER PANELS: EXTRA image 2 = the "before" panel, EXTRA image 3 = the "after" panel. Use both EXACTLY as supplied, pixel for pixel, same position, same size and same white "before" / "after" pill labels as the reference — never redraw, re-texture or regenerate them.
SUB-LINE under the panels (same two-line style, same size, centred): bold "LACALUT Sensitive" then regular weight: "seals the microscopic holes and cracks that make teeth and gums so sensitive."
PRODUCT: the attached LACALUT Sensitive tube replaces the White & Repair tube in the SAME bottom position, SAME angle, SAME crop off the bottom-right edge, label facing camera, entering from the LEFT. Keep its real teal/white label exactly as supplied; never let the crop cut the LACALUT wordmark.

LACALUT PRODUCT (from the SECOND attached image onward): reproduce the real packaging EXACTLY — shape, label layout, colours, logo and wording; real proportions (a tall slim 75ml tube, never squat); only the LACALUT wordmark and variant name may read clearly, all small printed pack text stays in its ORIGINAL GERMAN and softly out of focus — NEVER legible English health words on the pack. Never invent, add or duplicate any other product, tube, box, bottle or brush. STRICT COMPLIANCE (cosmetic-only, non-negotiable): never show or write gingivitis, periodontitis, gum disease, halitosis, reverses the condition, graphic bleeding gums close-up, bleeding, reduces bleeding, stops bleeding, stops gum bleeding, gum bleeding, soothes, soothes irritation, irritation, inflammation, reduces inflammation, anti-inflammatory, heals, calms, closes gum pockets, kills bacteria, kills the bacteria, clinically proven, clinically tested, clinical trial, gum health, oral health, dental health, healthy tissue, healthy gums, dentist approved, dentist recommended, pain relief, pain-free cure, therapeutic; never a medical cross, never a disease or treatment claim, never "clinically proven", never a doctor endorsement unless the reference's equivalent line was explicitly rewritten by the art director. If a competitor line would breach this, keep its size/position but soften the wording to a cosmetic feel/benefit. TITLE CASE ALL HEADERS (Quan's #1 header rule, never break): the headline AND every sub-headline are written in Title Case — capitalise every significant word; small words (a, an, the, and, or, in, of, to, for, with, on, at) stay lowercase unless they are the first word. This overrides the reference ad's own casing (even if their headline is in sentence case). Body lines and fine print keep the casing given in the changes. TEXT RULES: all text in Australian English, spelled exactly as given, crisp and legible at thumbnail size. Do NOT add any headline, badge, trust seal, star row, review, CTA pill, URL, price or logo that the reference does not have. Do NOT remove any element the reference has. OUTPUT FORMAT — ALWAYS 4:5 PORTRAIT (1080×1350), even when the reference is square or landscape (Quan 15/10/2026, never break). Keep the reference's element order and styling top to bottom, and use the extra vertical space to make the main elements BIGGER — never add new elements, never leave an empty band. 4:5 portrait aspect ratio, full-bleed edge to edge. Output ONE finished image.
